title: Have Household Hazardous Waste? Toss them here.
description:
Safely get rid of your household hazardous waste! San Diego residents can now drop off items such as batteries, paint, and motor oil on Wednesdays and Saturdays for free. 🔋 🖌️

Three easy steps: 
1. Visit sandiego.gov/HHW.
2. Schedule an appointment.
3. Follow instructions upon arrival at the Transfer Facility (on Convoy Street north of 52).

For more information and to make an appointment, visit sandiego.gov/HHW.

#CityOfSanDiego #RecycleRight
